steps.en: Install it on a machine where your agent CLI is already signed in
steps.zh: 在已登录 Agent CLI 的电脑上安装

steps.en: Clones the latest release, detects your agent and starts the background hub
steps.zh: 克隆最新 Release，检测已装的 Agent，启动后台中台

steps.en: Declare what happened, which agent handles it and in which folder
steps.zh: 写清发生什么、交给哪个 Agent、在哪个目录

steps.en: On the event, runs the agent for one round; a question becomes a card and the process exits
steps.zh: 事件到来时让 Agent 跑一轮；要问的事变成卡片，进程退出

steps.en: Answer the card in Feishu, a desktop notification or the CLI
steps.zh: 在飞书、桌面通知或命令行回答卡片

steps.en: Resumes the original agent session with your answer and finishes the job
steps.zh: 带着你的回答接回原会话，把活做完

value.en: You stop babysitting a terminal: work runs in the background and only decisions reach you, with no tokens spent while you think
value.zh: 不用守着终端：活在后台跑，只有要你拍板的事才找你，等你时不花 Token
